limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the normal-mode deduction guard but changed both warning lights to use the post-update balance instead of the pre-update balance, shifting their timing by a clock cycle at threshold crossings.
The test derived both expected warning values from the post-update balance, so it caught the original balance bug but could not flag the warning-timing regression.

limitations.quote: The last line of the patch must be '*** End Patch'
limitations.note: The malformed patch applied nothing and had to be resubmitted.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before the simulation could run.
